<thought>We need to provide at least one list‑type criterion to the template search. Supplying an empty list for a criterion satisfies the requirement and returns templates for the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": [],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
